purpose: Measure the failure-conditioned WCT regime AegisKV is designed for without changing or replacing the broad preliminary matrix.
selection_disclosure: This rectangular follow-up was locked after inspecting the broad campaign and exploratory diagnostics. It is targeted preliminary evidence, not an independently preregistered primary result.

hardware_model.coverage_note: AegisKV retains the same remote DRAM path as Native Mooncake and adds same-node Peer-HBM for isolated worker/GPU failure.

failure_model.interpretation: Warm replacement is already available; WCT isolates KV recovery and queue propagation. The 500 ms cells include a common takeover cost for every policy.

estimands.primary: Paired mean affected-workflow WCT reduction versus modeled Native Mooncake over the union of workflows affected in either policy.

evidence_boundary: Targeted SGLSim metadata DES preliminary result. It is not physical A100 evidence, not production Mooncake failover, not paper-ready, and must be reported beside the broad near-null matrix and the selection disclosure.
